lines.en: Long tusks jut from my jaw.
Two and a half blocks tall, and loud.
A row of plates runs down my back.

lines.zh: 沙漠的沙被我一脚踩陷
lines.en: The desert sand sinks under my step.
Short arms, very long tusks.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方石头翻起来
lines.en: Stones turn up where I walk.
The sand sinks with every step I take.
Red badland soil cakes my feet.
I lumber along as I walk.
My tail drags through the sand.
Heat doesn't bother me.
I can carry a rider.
I open my mouth; my tusks clack.
Two rows of prints in the sand.
I stand, breathing heavily.

lines.zh: 我这身有一百多点生命
lines.en: This body has over a hundred points.
My tusks are my hardest part.
The desert wind can't move me.
There's a meat smell in the air.
I can be put to work.
My feet press into the sand.
Sun beats on my back plates.
I lick the tip of a tusk.
I'm waiting for the next meal.
I know these dunes well.
I lower my head and sniff the sand.
I swing my heavy tail.

lines.zh: 都退开，我不爱被围着看
lines.en: Stand back, all of you — I hate being stared at.
You're a head shorter than me.
These tusks aren't decoration.
Back off, or I'll gore.
I see what's in your hand.
I'm not the wild kind of vicious.
If I have a master, I obey.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，牙会碰到你
lines.en: You're too close — my tusks will touch you.
Old marks still show on my tusks.
Meat scent clings to you.
I'm deciding if you're food.
When I open my mouth, don't move.
My nose is dull; my eyes are sharp.
Don't touch my tusks.

lines.zh: 我这身体能扛不少东西
lines.en: This body carries plenty.
One step back and we can talk.
I don't often start things.
One step back; the tusks hold.
My hide's thick; that's little.

lines.zh: 背上那道口子还在渗血
lines.en: The gash on my back is still bleeding.

lines.zh: 脑袋一晃，牙上的血甩掉
lines.en: I shake my head and fling the blood off my tusks.
I clenched my tusks.
I can still gore.
I gave a deep grunt.
I remember where you hit.
My belly's still empty.
My teeth are still clenched; I don't yield.
Meat? Toss it over.
I eat this, nothing else.
That won't even pick my teeth.
I want it raw, not cooked.
Set it down and back off.
My tusks bite quickly.
This isn't enough to chew.
Push that meat a little closer to my mouth.
I'll lick my tusks afterward.
Don't raise it; my neck is short.
The smell of blood suits me best.
Bring more next time.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的前腿，弹开了
lines.en: You hit my foreleg and bounce off.
I didn't even turn my head.

lines.zh: 我的肩一顶，你滑了半步
lines.en: One shove of my shoulder and you slide half a step.
My hide is hard.
That bump doesn't even turn my head.
My tusks caught you.
Move; I'm wide.
The ground crumbles under me.
You retreat to my flank.
Squeeze again and I'll turn.
I'll see how sturdy you are.
This body is built for work.
These tusks aren't gifts.
Desert living isn't easy.
Talk once I've eaten.
Don't stand so far forward.
I usually don't talk much.
This takes slow getting used to.
I haven't even picked a master.
Don't keep me from the sun.
There's meat in the sand.
I hook the meat up on my tusk tip.
I eat the sand with it.
I swallow this in one go.
It tastes fine even in sand.
I pin it down under my forefoot.
I don't need a bowl.
This keeps me chewing a while.
I keep the bones too.
Don't touch it.
I've opened my mouth.
My tusks are aimed at you.
My charge is heavy.
There's no cover in this desert.
The smell of meat excites me.

lines.zh: 牙先探出去，你再退就晚了
lines.en: My tusks go out first; too late to back away.
You can't block this one.
Short arms, but the tusks reach.
Run, and I'll follow.
These dunes are mine.
I know you're alive.
Better brace yourself.
I lower my weight and shuffle forward.
My tusks never leave you.
The sand sinks under my weight.
Speed isn't how I win.
One step back from you, one step forward from me.
I hear your feet in the sand.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚跟，不着急
lines.en: I keep my eyes on your heels, unhurried.
My jaws opening is loud.
You're measuring my reach.
So am I.
Two more steps is enough.
I don't need to run.
I gore with my tusks.
One bite, straight down.
My forefoot slams the sand.
This one carries my weight.
You're lifted off the ground.
I shake my head side to side.
A tusk opens a gash.
My tail sweeps across and knocks you down.
You back against the dune.
I gore once more.
Sand flies everywhere.

lines.zh: 撞完我退开，看你倒没倒
lines.en: After the charge I step back to see if you fall.
Something moved under the dune.
The tusks show first.

lines.zh: 沙丘裂开，我抖落一身沙
lines.en: The dune splits and I shake the sand off.
Red badland dust billows up.

lines.zh: 红土扬起，我踏出第一步
lines.en: Red dust rises as I take my first step.
This desert is my ground.
I smell meat.
The sun's fierce; just right.
I leave my first footprint.
I open my jaws once.
My tusks are harder than sand.
There's a living scent on the wind.
I plant my feet.
There's room here to turn.
Fire is only a little hot to me.
I fell and my back plates hit sand.
In water I can't lift a leg.
The blast pushed me back two steps.
Something struck my back plates.
This force makes me sway.
Too hungry to even move my tusks.
Lightning hit my back plates; I went numb.

lines.zh: 沙子全漏下去，我踩空了
lines.en: The sand drains away and my feet find nothing.
